rules.title: 📖 Rules and exchange rates
rules.predatorsText: 🦊 The fox eats rabbits and sheep. 🐺 The wolf hunts pigs, cows and horses. A small dog 🐕 chases off the fox, a big dog 🐕‍🦺 chases off the wolf — but the dog returns to the shared pool after defending, so you'll need to earn a new one.
rules.winText: You win once you hold at least 1 of every animal (rabbit, sheep, pig, cow, horse) and both dogs at the same time.
